result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position: audits are limited to once per 12 months, require 30 days’ written notice, occur during business hours, are conducted through an independent confidentiality-bound auditor, and prohibit access to Company systems. Keeping all inspection costs with HDI is more protective of the Customer than the playbook’s permitted cost-shifting exception. The changes are targeted and preserve the audit’s original scope, though the inherited phrasing “may ... have the right” is slightly awkward.
